title: Contract Seasoning Reduction of Good-Faith Days
content:
**Clause.** A deferral qualifying payment on Kestrel Auto Finance Retail Installment Contracts also carries a good-faith amount, applied to principal, equal to one day's interest on the principal balance at the contract APR over the tier's day-count basis multiplied by the good-faith days and rounded to the cent. The good-faith days are lowered by a seasoning reduction counted in whole months from the contract date to the payment date, and they are never below zero.

| Contract age on the payment date | Days subtracted |
|---|---|
| at least 24 whole months | long-seasoning reduction days: 3 |
| 12 to 23 whole months | mid-seasoning reduction days: 1 |
| fewer than 12 whole months | none |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical, contract date 2024-03-15)

| Payment date | Whole months | Days subtracted |
|---|---|---|
| 2026-03-15 | 24 | 3 |
| 2026-03-14 | 23 | 1 |
| 2025-03-15 | 12 | 1 |
| 2025-03-14 | 11 | none |

## Points of judgement

- Good-faith days of 20 on a contract 30 whole months old become 17.
- Good-faith days of 2 on a contract 26 whole months old would fall to minus 1; they stop at zero, so the good-faith amount is 0.00.
- A contract with no good-faith days to begin with keeps none; the reduction never creates a negative amount.
